response.justification: Bogdan Szabo’s resume demonstrates strong expertise in software development, particularly in web and backend systems, with relevant experience in performance optimization and hardware-software co-design (e.g., robotic arms, real-time note-taking tools). However, his background lacks direct experience with AI accelerators, SoC/IP modeling, deep-learning workload optimization, or GPU architecture—core requirements for the Principal Performance Architect role. His educational background (Bachelor’s in CS) and years of experience (10+ years) partially meet the qualifications, but the absence of domain-specific expertise in hardware optimization for AI systems significantly reduces his fit.
strengths: Extensive experience in performance optimization and system architecture across diverse domains (e.g., robotic arms, real-time systems).
Proven track record in full-stack development, testing, and automation (e.g., CI/CD, TDD, CI servers).
Strong open-source contributions and leadership in community-driven projects (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
concerns: No demonstrated experience with AI accelerators, SoC/IP modeling, or deep-learning workload optimization.
Lacks GPU architecture or SIMD/MIMD experience explicitly required for the role.
Educational background (Bachelor’s) and experience do not align closely with the Principal-level hardware-software co-design requirements.

key_factors.factor: Years of experience and educational alignment
